payload.title: M0 Spike: render one Anth.us article page in a Lambda, byte-identical and timed
payload.description:
## Outcome
Papyrus has a projection library and a default "s3-projection" publication option for Markus sites: a versioned site bucket, the projector inside the content-actions Lambda, a CloudFront Function + KeyValueStore (directory index and redirects), IAM, and a config field. Publishing or saving a live item writes its page to the bucket inside the mutation.

## Design
/Users/home/Projects/markus-publication-architecture-v2.md sections 2 (Target architecture), 4 (Code layout, API hook, concurrency), 5 (Default publication option).

## Checklist
- [ ] papyrus_content.projection: project(item_id), project_listings(), project_all(); idempotent; Markus in-process (byte-identical, plus trailing newline as the CLI)
- [ ] SiteProjector interface (item_pages, dependent_pages, static_files, redirects)
- [ ] Ordered S3 writes with x-amz-meta-papyrus-version; targeted CreateInvalidation of written paths
- [ ] publishItem / saveItem (live item) / unpublishItem call project(); response gains live, paths, url; failure returns live:false without failing the save
- [ ] Config: backend.publication { kind: "s3-projection", projector, edgeDistributionArn }; default for renderer markus
- [ ] site-backend.ts: versioned bucket (OAC-only policy), KVS + CloudFront Function, IAM (s3 put/delete on the bucket, cloudfront:CreateInvalidation), DLQ
- [ ] papyrus ops site project-all / project --items CLI (IAM)

## Acceptance
- Synth snapshot: a markus fixture site gets bucket (versioning on), function, KVS, IAM; pretext/example sites unchanged.
- In a sandbox: publish of a test item writes its page; HEAD shows papyrus-version = PublishedItem.versionNumber; mutation p50 latency recorded.
- project_all to a local directory equals today's build output for a fixture site (diff -r empty).

## Out of scope
Renditions (M2), full dependency rules for real sites (M3), cache tuning (M4), site migrations (M5, M6).

## Dependencies
Blocked by M0 spike.

## Risk
Medium: the Lambda becomes part of the publish path; keep save and projection failure separate.

## Estimate
8-12 agent-hours.
